subject: Action Required: Verification for prompt-output and trace purging — GreenBridge Health
messages:
From: Elena Morales <security@greenbridgehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Purge of prompt-output & request-trace logs (GDPR request 2028-04-09)

Jordan —

Thanks for taking this. Per our data subject request (attached) we need Redwood to permanently remove all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and associated request/trace logs for user account GBH-42 (GreenBridge patient-test) created prior to 2028-01-01. We are providing an export of our identifiers and a CSV of sample request IDs (attached: data-access-log-2028-04-10.csv).

Requirements: a) purge the prompt-output store and KV cache entries, b) scrub request traces and audit logs (where allowed), c) provide an auditable archive showing files removed and the purge commands executed. We also need the confirmation to include checksums for the archive and a signed statement from Redwood indicating the purge completed.

Please confirm scope and expected timeline.

Best,
Elena Morales
Security & Privacy 
GreenBridge Health

Attachments: data-access-log-2028-04-10.csv (CSV of request IDs, 12 lines)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <security@greenbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 17:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Purge of prompt-output & request-trace logs (GDPR request 2028-04-09)

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear scope and the CSV. We can handle this. High-level plan:
- Redwood will remove prompt inputs/outputs and associated KV cache entries for the listed request IDs and any associated prompt-output artifacts for account GBH-42.
- We will scrub request traces and redact any PII from system audit logs to the extent our compliance policy allows; certain infrastructure-level telemetry (timestamp, shard id) will remain but will be dissociated from GBH-42.
- We will produce an audit bundle (zip) containing: script run logs, deletion receipts, checksums (SHA256) and an internal signed confirmation PDF.

Timeline: we will start the purge job on Thu 2028-04-12 and expect to complete by end-of-day (PST) the same day. I will send the final confirmation and the audit bundle link when complete.

Two quick asks:
1) Can you confirm whether the CSV includes all historical request IDs you want purged, or whether we should also scan by account GBH-42 identifier? (Scanning will add ~1 hour to the window.)
2) Please confirm whether GreenBridge requires redaction of the system-level request traces (we can either fully delete the trace file or return a redacted copy).

Jordan Blake
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:22:37 -0700
Subject: Internal: GBH purge run plan and checklist

Team —

Per Elena's request, I'm scheduling the purge for Thu 2028-04-12 09:00 PST. Monica, can you own the audit bundle creation and checksum verification? Marissa, please coordinate the runtime (Dedicated pool job) and the post-run validation that no prompt-output artifacts remain for GBH-42.

Proposed checklist (keep minimal to meet SLA):
- PRE-RUN: snapshot metadata (db snapshot id, kv-index versions), export list of target object keys (S3 prefix and internal object ids).
- RUN: execute redwood_purge_script_v1.sh against S3 prefix and internal stores with --dryrun flag first, capture run logs; then actual run with --confirm.
- POST-RUN: run discovery scan for any remaining keys matching GBH-42, generate report (discovery-report.txt).
- BUNDLE: package run logs, discovery-report.txt, checksums.txt, and signed_confirmation_greenbridge.pdf into audit_bundle_greenbridge_20280412.zip. Upload to internal Drive and provide read-only link.
- COMMUNICATE: send signed confirmation and the Drive link to client; include the SHA256 checksums and the list of deleted object IDs.

Notes on redaction: if client requests trace deletion vs redaction, we should prefer deletion for customer-specific traces. For infra-level logs where deletion isn't permitted, we will provide a redacted copy and a statement of dissociation.

Marissa/Monica — confirm ownerships and I will book the Dedicated window.

Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 10:04:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: GBH purge run plan and checklist

Sounds good — I will provision a 2-hour Dedicated slot starting 09:00 PST Thu and run the job.
Dry run scheduled for 08:00 PST same day. Monica — I'll hand you the run logs at 11:30 for bundling.

—Marissa
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <security@greenbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, DocuSign <no-reply@docusign.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 17:03:23 -0700
Subject: Confirmation: Purge completed for GBH-42 — audit bundle & signed confirmation attached

Elena —

We completed the purge window for GBH-42 today. Summary: 
- Scope: All prompt inputs, generated outputs, KV-cache entries, and customer-scoped request traces for the IDs provided and any discovered/request-mapped artifacts prior to 2028-01-01.
- Actions taken: ran redwood_purge_script_v1.sh (attached) against S3 prefix s3://redwood-prod/gbh-42/, removed 1,248 object keys and flushed 3 KV cache shards.
- Artifacts provided: audit_bundle_greenbridge_20280412.zip (contains run logs, discovery-report.txt, checksums.txt, and signed_confirmation_greenbridge.pdf). SHA256(audit_bundle) = 3f7a9b2d4e5c6a1b2c... (truncated in email for brevity).

Attachments: audit_bundle_greenbridge_20280412.zip, signed_confirmation_greenbridge.pdf. The Drive link to the bundle (read-only): https://drive.redwood.internal/shared/GBH/purge-audit-20280412

One note on infra-level telemetry: we dissociated GBH-42 from system-level traces where deletion is restricted; a redacted copy of infra logs was included in the bundle and the redaction summary is in discovery-report.txt.

Let us know if you need the full checksums file or a notarized statement; I've also initiated a DocuSign confirmation to the email on the request — you should receive it shortly.

Thanks — closing out on our side unless you request further action.

Jordan Blake
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: audit_bundle_greenbridge_20280412.zip (5.1 MB), signed_confirmation_greenbridge.pdf (24 KB)
